svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bar: 32 mm tube 680 long. Posts: 25 x 25 tube, 2 x 364 long,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 640 apart centre to centre, saddle-coped to the bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grip tubes: 22.2 mm tube, 2 x 277 long, along the posts' line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: coped to the back of the bar, pointing back toward the user.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld on a flat table with the posts square to the bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Height holes: nine 6.5 mm holes through each post, front to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back, 25 apart; the top one 75 below the bar centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the posts slide into the hip sleeves (1 mm clearance each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side); a 6 mm pin through sleeve and post holds the height,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bar centre 850 to 1,050 above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both posts enter and slide together without binding.
